newsitem.title: CHILE: Phelps Dodge Chile copper mine on strike.
newsitem.headline: Phelps Dodge Chile copper mine on strike.

text.p: Workers at Phelps Dodge's Candelaria copper mine in northern Chile have been on strike since Monday but production at the pit has not been affected, said a mine spokesman Friday.
The spokesman told Reuters that 206 workers belonging to the mine's union were on strike, while 440 other miners at the pit were working normally.
Candelaria, which produces 150,000 tonnes of copper a year, has managed to maintain production by using stocks and by reorganizing the mine's workforce, he said.
"Production is practically normal. We have full stocks and are continuing operations by reorganizing personnel," he said.
Most of the strikers work at the mine's pit, he said.
The walkout started following a break-down in scheduled wage talks, he said. The last collective labor contract, which lasted two years, ended on October 31.
The spokesman said strikers are demanding an increase in their basic wage whereas management has offered a productivity-related deal.
Talks are continuing to resolve the dispute, he said.
The strike is the third this year to hit Chile's copper mining industry and follows walkouts at state copper giant Codelco's Chuquicamata and Salvador pits.
